new_foods.source: PROVISIONAL (nalt-names-13): Martinez Steele et al., J Nutr2023 Table1 Group1, "Lentils, chickpeas, and other legumes" and "Natural, packaged, cut, chilled or frozen vegetables, fruits, potatoes, cassava, and other roots and tubers"; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10127522/ . Exact term greengram is not named: class-instance of these plain-food classes, not an exact-named food or NOVA placement supplied by NALT. Plain edible Vigna radiata pulse, including whole or split seeds, not an assertion that whole seeds equal split dal. NALT Product16192 names greengram and mungbeans (https://lod.nal.usda.gov/nalt/16192); the IISc-hosted Pulses of Life proceedings explicitly describe whole and split pulse use (https://wgbis.ces.iisc.ac.in/energy/lake2016/proceedings/Keynote/T4_PULSES_OF_LIFE-MDS.pdf). No alias to moong dal is added or changed. Positive minimal-process scope from Monteiro et al., FAO2019 Table1 Group1 (https://www.fao.org/4/ca5644en/ca5644en.pdf): "Unprocessed foods altered by industrial processes such as removal of inedible or unwanted parts, drying, powdering, squeezing, crushing, grinding, fractioning, steaming, poaching, boiling, roasting, and pasteurization, chilling, freezing, placing in containers, vacuum packaging, non-alcoholic fermentation, and other methods that do not add salt, sugar, oils or fats or other food substances to the original food." This condition applies to the same original food without added substances, not an unspecified powder, flour, extract, oil, isolate, recipe or preserved product. Explicit same-food-only composition is required for ambiguous grinding/powder forms. Leaves, hulls, straw, forage, hay and silage are outside this seed/pod admission. Not a strong marker. Table1 Group3 in Martinez Steele et al. separately states "These are relatively simple products manufactured essentially with the addition of salt or sugar or other substances of common culinary use, such as oil or vinegar, to unprocessed or minimally processed foods." Existing item-own salt/sugar/brine and unknown-condition guards are unchanged.
